pdf_script = '''import fitz
import docx

# Read the Word document
doc = docx.Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Extract all paragraph text
lines = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if text:
        lines.append(text)

# Also extract table content
for table in doc.tables:
    for row in table.rows:
        row_text = " | ".join(cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells)
        if row_text.strip("| "):
            lines.append(row_text)

# Create PDF with fitz
pdf_doc = fitz.open()

# Page settings
page_width = 595  # A4
page_height = 842
margin = 50
usable_width = page_width - 2 * margin
y_pos = margin
font_size_title = 16
font_size_heading = 13
font_size_body = 10
line_spacing = 1.4

page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)

for line in lines:
    # Determine style
    if line == "Customer Activity Report":
        fs = font_size_title
        font = "helv"
        color = (0.1, 0.1, 0.5)
    elif line.startswith("Order ORD-") or line in ("Maya Chen", "Jordan Alvarez", "Evan Parker", "Nina Patel", "Alicia Morgan", "Sofia Ramirez"):
        fs = font_size_heading
        font = "helv"
        color = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    else:
        fs = font_size_body
        font = "helv"
        color = (0.2, 0.2, 0.2)

    # Check if we need a new page
    if y_pos + fs * line_spacing > page_height - margin:
        page = pdf_doc.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
        y_pos = margin

    # Insert text
    text_point = fitz.Point(margin, y_pos + fs)
    page.insert_text(text_point, line, fontsize=fs, fontname=font, color=color)
    y_pos += fs * line_spacing

pdf_doc.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf_doc.close()
print("PDF created successfully at /workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
await write_file("./convert_docx_to_pdf.py", pdf_script)
print("Script written")

pdf_create_out = await run_command("python ./convert_docx_to_pdf.py")
